name: Main Character Energy
source:
When a mysterious bookstore clerk installs a new story app on your phone, you find yourself thrown into the world of Choices.

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Main_Character_Energy]Choices Wikia[/url]]
